quotaChallenge.title: Terminal output quota
quotaChallenge.warning: Output is still growing; left unanswered, this terminal will be terminated automatically.

exitReason.quota_unanswered: Output reached the quota limit and the confirmation prompt was not answered in time, so this terminal was stopped. For long-running noisy commands, redirect output to a file with "cmd > log 2>&1".
exitReason.quota_hard_cap: Output reached the hard cap, so this terminal was stopped. For long-running noisy commands, redirect output to a file with "cmd > log 2>&1".
exitReason.quota_denied: You chose to terminate this terminal (the output quota confirmation was denied).
exitReason.ttl_expired: The lifetime window ran out, so this terminal was closed automatically. Need it longer? Renew from the terminal card's More → Lifetime menu (up to 24h per grant).
